name: Koiken Otome ~Revive~
source:
This is the fandisk for Koiken Otome, focusing on subheroines Chiharu, Shiho and Mari. There are also after stories for the 4 heroines from the original game and an intense episode with the Kotona.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/04/01/april-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《恋剑乙女》的同人盘，主要关注女主角千春、志保和麻里。还有原版游戏中4名女主角的后续故事以及与Kotona的紧张情节。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/04/01/april-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
